title: 第2473章 二十余年的变化第2472章 忆相逢
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 还未等莫阳开口，徐青便朝着莫阳冲了过来，似乎还有些不相信眼前的一切是真的，冲到莫阳身前，先是伸手在莫阳肩上重重拍了拍，随后一脸惊喜的开口道：“竟然是真的，莫兄，你竟然真的回来了！”
徐青的修为虽然比不上季飞尘，但也不弱，之前从道门圣女口中，莫阳便听说徐青已经步入了造化境。
虽然还停留在造化境一阶巅峰，但这样的修为，哪怕放在如今的荒域上，也很强了。
虽然和季飞尘相差了足足一个大境界，是因为他和季飞尘所走的路完全不一样，而且季飞尘经历了太多常人难以承受的磨炼，不说季飞尘曾经被困那段时光，之前还曾历经修为大跌，算是破而后立。
故人相见，莫阳很是感慨，不过更多的是高兴，他伸手拍了拍徐青的肩头，笑道：“刚才听季兄说你特意准备了不少神仙醉，就等着我们相见大醉一场，赶紧拿出来吧！”
徐青闻言哈哈大笑起来，抬手一挥，直接从随身纳戒中取出数十坛神仙醉，开口道：“季师兄可盯着我这神仙醉很久了，只是一直没得逞，今日敞开了喝，管够！”
随后徐青围着莫阳转了几圈，认认真真的上下打量莫阳，随即皱眉道：“莫兄，你如今什么修为了？”
因为他此时去感应莫阳，竟然无法从莫阳身上感应到丝毫修者的波动，站在他面前的如同一个普通人一样。
不等莫阳开口，徐青便接着道：“莫兄，你一走就是二十余年，虽然对于正常人而言修为越强修炼的速度就会越慢，但你明显不是正常人，我竟然丝毫感应不到你身上的真气波动……你如今不会已经迈入准帝境了吧！”
虽然二十余年对于修者来说算不得什么，但徐青深知莫阳不同寻常，这些年，他们修为也都成长很快，更何况是莫阳这种怪物呢。
而且他反复感应，都没能从莫阳身上感应到真气波动，要知道季飞尘已经踏足不朽境，修为气息再如何隐晦，他依旧能感应到，但莫阳给他的感觉却完全不一样。
莫阳笑了笑，开口道：“离开这些年，确实遇到了一些机缘！”
虽然莫阳没有直接回应，但徐青也听得出来，他的猜测竟然没错，莫阳绝对已经踏足准帝境了。
一旁的季飞尘看着直接愣在原地的徐青一眼，开口道：“这有什么可惊讶的，倘若换成其他人，确实是匪夷所思的事情，但放在莫兄身上，别说只是迈入准帝境，就算是准帝境巅峰，在我看来这也是理所应当的！”
他说完目光在莫阳身上认真打量了片刻，而后笑着朝徐青开口道：“而且我觉得你猜测还是不够大胆，依我看，莫兄的修为至少在准帝境七阶以上！”
季飞尘虽然是笑着开口，但却说的很认真，而且语气很笃定，这让刚想开口的徐青再度一愣，随后一脸不可思议的看向莫阳，等着莫阳开口。
对此，莫阳并不觉得奇怪，季飞尘毕竟是一个不朽境的强者。
“莫兄，你别光笑啊，季师兄说的对不对？”徐青盯着莫阳，看到莫阳没有开口反驳，他心中其实已经有了答案了，但还是想听莫阳亲口说。
莫阳开口道：“刚才我不是说了吗，离开这些年，我确实遇到一些机缘，发生了很多事情，我们边喝边聊！”
听到这句话，徐青再次愣在原地，几息后才喃喃开口道：“卧槽……准帝境七阶……那岂不是无敌了……”
季飞尘笑着摇了摇头，他刚才见到莫阳时，心中也吃惊，因为当时他就有所猜测了，看着莫阳，恍惚间甚至感觉像是面对一个屹立在武道巅峰的大帝一样，那种威势无与伦比。
他之所以只敢猜测是准帝境七阶以上，是因为联想莫阳的战力都远超自身修为。
徐青愣了许久才回过神来，像是看怪物一样盯着莫阳看了又看，随后唉声叹气的开口道：“之前我和季师兄还以为你这么多年不出现会不会是遇到什么麻烦事了，还寻思什么时候去找你，哎，如今看来还是我太年轻了……”
“以莫兄你的战力，修为达到这等境界，恐怕帝境之下都已经难逢敌手了吧。”
莫阳提起一坛神仙醉递给徐青，开口道：“之前我去了一个名为玄域的大陆，在那里遇上了一些事情，才知道修炼界根本不是表面看到的那么回事。”
听到莫阳这话，季飞尘和徐青都面露一丝疑惑之色，只听莫阳接着轻叹道：“古籍中都记载自从天道法则变化后，帝者便无法长生，而活下来的帝级强者并不在少数，如今存世的准帝，有一部分便是曾经的大帝。”
对于这种事情，季飞尘和徐青都是第一次听说，两人眼中浮起了难以置信的神色。
而莫阳之所以主动提起这些，是因为如今的季飞尘和徐青修为都已经不弱，终有一日或许都能踏足准帝境，甚至走得更远，莫阳是故意提醒他们。
“莫兄，真有这种事情？”季飞尘也忍不住开口问，还是感觉难以置信。
莫阳轻叹道：“我也是这些年才知晓一些，曾经的一些帝级强者确实通过各种手段活了下来，而且一部分强者所选择的手段极其极端，将来你们要提防！”
徐青忍不住开口道：“如此说来，荒域上岂不是也还有大帝隐伏在暗中！”
莫阳沉吟片刻，开口道：“每一个大陆都远比我们所看到的要神秘和复杂。”
季飞尘看着莫阳，沉声道：“我们在那些强者眼中与蝼蚁无异，那等强者恐怕也不会留意我等，真正要提防的是莫兄你。”
莫阳没有开口，对于寻常的帝级强者，他早已无惧。
此时徐青起身开口道：“这些事情过了今日再说，隔了这么多年，先喝个痛快，你们稍等，我去准备一些小菜。”
他说完便直接腾空离去了。
content_en:
Before Mo Yang could speak, Xu Qing rushed towards Mo Yang, as if he still didn't believe that everything in front of him was real. He rushed to Mo Yang, first reached out and patted Mo Yang hard on the shoulder, and then said with a look of surprise: "It's true, Brother Mo, you are really back!"
Although Xu Qing's cultivation level is not as good as Ji Feichen's, it is not weak either. Mo Yang had heard from the Taoist Saint before that Xu Qing had entered the realm of creation.
Although he is still at the peak of the first level of the Creation Realm, such a level of cultivation is still very strong even in today's wilderness.
Although there is a big difference between him and Ji Feichen, it is because he and Ji Feichen have taken completely different paths, and Ji Feichen has experienced too many hardships that are unbearable for ordinary people. Not to mention the time when Ji Feichen was trapped, he also experienced a sharp decline in his cultivation level before, which can be regarded as breaking and then standing up.
Mo Yang was very emotional when old friends met, but more than anything, he was happy. He reached out and patted Xu Qing's shoulder, and said with a smile: "I just heard from Brother Ji that you specially prepared a lot of immortal drunken wine, just waiting for us to get drunk when we meet. Take it out quickly!"
Xu Qing laughed loudly after hearing this, raised his hand and took out dozens of altars of immortal drunkenness from the ring he carried with him, and said: "Senior Brother Ji has been staring at me, the immortal drunken drinker, for a long time, but he has never succeeded. I opened my mouth to drink today. Enough!"
Xu Qing then walked around Mo Yang a few times, looked at Mo Yang seriously, then frowned and said: "Brother Mo, what level of cultivation are you at now?"
Because when he went to sense Mo Yang at this time, he was unable to sense the slightest fluctuation of cultivators from Mo Yang. The person standing in front of him was like an ordinary person.
Before Mo Yang could speak, Xu Qing continued: "Brother Mo, you have been gone for more than 20 years. Although for normal people, the stronger the cultivation level, the slower the speed of cultivation, but you are obviously not a normal person. I can't sense the fluctuation of zhenqi in your body at all... You have entered the quasi-emperor realm now, right?"
Although more than twenty years is nothing to a cultivator, Xu Qing knows that Mo Yang is unusual. Their cultivation has also grown rapidly in these years, let alone a monster like Mo Yang.
Moreover, despite repeated inductions, he could not detect the true energy fluctuations from Mo Yang. You must know that Ji Feichen has stepped into the immortal realm. No matter how obscure the cultivation aura is, he can still sense it, but the feeling Mo Yang gives him is completely different.
Mo Yang smiled and said, "I have indeed encountered some opportunities after leaving these years!"
Although Mo Yang did not respond directly, Xu Qing could tell that his guess was correct. Mo Yang had definitely reached the quasi-emperor realm.
Ji Feichen on the side looked at Xu Qing, who was stunned on the spot, and said: "What's surprising about this? If it were anyone else, it would be unbelievable, but for Brother Mo, let alone just entering the quasi-emperor realm, even if he is at the peak of the quasi-emperor realm, in my opinion, this is natural!"
After he finished speaking, he looked at Mo Yang seriously for a moment, then smiled and said to Xu Qing: "And I think your guess is not bold enough. In my opinion, Brother Mo's cultivation is at least the seventh level of the quasi-emperor realm!"
Although Ji Feichen spoke with a smile, he said it very seriously and in a very determined tone. This made Xu Qing, who was about to speak, stunned again, and then looked at Mo Yang with an incredulous look, waiting for Mo Yang to speak.
Mo Yang was not surprised by this, Ji Feichen was a strong man in the immortal realm after all.
"Brother Mo, don't just laugh. Is Senior Brother Ji right?" Xu Qing stared at Mo Yang and saw that Mo Yang didn't open his mouth to refute. He actually already had the answer in his heart, but he still wanted to hear Mo Yang say it himself.
Mo Yang said: "Didn't I just say that I did encounter some opportunities and a lot of things happened after these years away? Let's chat while drinking!"
Hearing these words, Xu Qing froze on the spot again, and after a few breaths he murmured: "Fuck... the seventh level of quasi-emperor realm... isn't that invincible..."
Ji Feichen smiled and shook his head. When he saw Mo Yang just now, he was also surprised, because he had already guessed at that time. Looking at Mo Yang, he felt like he was facing an emperor who stood at the pinnacle of martial arts. His power was unparalleled.
The reason why he only dared to guess that it was quasi-emperor level seven or above was because he thought Mo Yang's combat power far exceeded his own cultivation level.
Xu Qing was stunned for a long time before he came back to his senses. He stared at Mo Yang again and again as if he were looking at a monster, and then sighed and said: "Senior Brother Ji and I thought you might have encountered some trouble if you didn't show up for so many years, and we were wondering when to find you. Alas, it seems that I am still too young now..."
"Brother Mo, with your fighting power and your cultivation reaching this level, I'm afraid it's hard to find an opponent even at the Imperial level."
Mo Yang handed a jar of immortal drunkenness to Xu Qing and said, "I went to a continent called Xuanyu before, and encountered some things there, and then I realized that the world of cultivation is not what it seems on the surface."
Hearing Mo Yang's words, both Ji Feichen and Xu Qing had a look of doubt on their faces, and then Mo Yang sighed softly: "It is recorded in ancient books that since the changes in the laws of heaven, emperors cannot live forever, and there are not a few emperor-level experts who have survived. Some of the quasi-emperors alive today are the former emperors."
It was the first time for Ji Feichen and Xu Qing to hear about this kind of thing, and there were looks of disbelief in their eyes.
The reason why Mo Yang took the initiative to mention this is because Ji Feichen and Xu Qing are not weak now, and one day they may be able to set foot in the quasi-emperor realm, or even go further. Mo Yang deliberately reminded them.
"Brother Mo, is such a thing really possible?" Ji Feichen couldn't help but ask, still feeling unbelievable.
Mo Yang sighed softly: "I have only learned something in these years. Some emperor-level strong men in the past did survive through various means, and some of the strong men chose extremely extreme methods. You should be careful in the future!"
Xu Qing couldn't help but said: "In this case, there is also a great emperor lurking in the wilderness in the wilderness!"
Mo Yang pondered for a moment and then said: "Every continent is far more mysterious and complex than what we see."
Ji Feichen looked at Mo Yang and said in a deep voice: "We are no different from ants in the eyes of those strong people. I am afraid those strong people will not pay attention to us. The one we really need to be wary of is you, Brother Mo."
Mo Yang didn't speak. He was no longer afraid of ordinary emperor-level experts.
At this time, Xu Qing stood up and said: "We will talk about these things after today. After so many years, let's have a drink first. You guys wait a moment, I will prepare some side dishes."
After he finished speaking, he immediately took off and left.
title_en: Chapter 2473 Changes in more than twenty years Chapter 2472 Reunion
